reconciliation_meta.title: MoraJaws Strict Assertion Type Safety, Schema Validation & Test Execution Integrity
reconciliation_meta.auditor: Senior Software Engineer, Security Reviewer & Migration Engineer
reconciliation_meta.methodology: Pure dynamic ingestion of actual HTTP responses from loopback server execution; strict runtime typeof boolean assertion verification (status + functional); zero AST estimation; zero hardcoded PASS verdicts; zero truthy/string leakage.

metrics_distinction.discrepancy_explanation: Previous JSON showed 154 evidence items because naive regex for GET /api/tickets/:id also falsely matched 4 calls to GET /api/tickets/search. Segment-by-segment parsing and reserved subpath filtering aligns evidence items to exactly 150 executed requests (70 in Phase 14C.1 + 80 in Phase 14C.2).

recommendations: Keep quarantined archives in private quarantine/ storage ignored by git and inaccessible from web.
Never commit production database backups or zip archives to Git repository.
Retain backup files strictly in encrypted object storage (Supabase private bucket with RLS or Cloud KMS) rather than container filesystem.
